summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn: a multi-level cob home and its grounds sit within configured terrain, authored settlements and routes toward Lumenvale and Hearthmere. Shared terrain, builder and interaction modules support the scenery and residents; Violet and the lake rowboat add mountable flight and boating to the player experience.
places: places/main - live forest place: configured terrain, river, vegetation, Spawn/home grounds and authored routes toward Lumenvale and Hearthmere
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn hub: cob house, creek and grounds, lake/dock, wizard tower, Violet with four mount pads, rowboat, and west-road courier-post blueprint
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene + x-1z0.scene - neighboring structures and actors, including outlying tower/warden placements
places/main/cells/objects.scene - shared authored object placements for main
places/main/cells/x-1z-1.scene + x1z-1.scene + x1z0.scene + x0z-1.scene + x0z1.scene - neighboring authored environment, route and wildlife placements
places/main/config.yaml - atmosphere, terrain/materials, site and clearing marks, pale-cobble east/west highways and procedural decoration bindings
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry/default place, player and camera templates, lighting, arrival and UI
templates/player.js#player - player movement, gait, home interaction and delete-mode behaviors
places/main/config.yaml - forest terrain, Spawn gravity, river, site/path marks and seeded vegetation
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - procedural multi-level home around the tree, with cellar through roof deck
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#grounds-plan + #grand-avenue - visible flagstone paths connect plaza, home grounds and outbuildings
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#purple-dragon-blueprint - Violet's resting home by the wizard tower; four nearby press pads target her
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#lake-rowboat - kinematic mountable boat at the lake dock
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt/materialAt(ctx) contract for terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - seeded vegetation builders reused by decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js - shared solid geometry for bridges and roadside features
scripts/lib/yard-kit.js - geometry/material primitives reused by yard and garden generators
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and interaction tuning
scripts/lib/data/player.yml + scripts/lib/data/ropes.js - player movement, flight and rope tuning
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - shared mount/seat/step-off logic; dragon and rowboat use mount input, seat placement and camera restoration
scripts/lib/data/dragon.js + scripts/lib/dragon-clips.js and scripts/lib/data/purple-dragon.js + purple-dragon-clips.js - separate tuning and animation clips for jade and Violet dragons
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber(value,fallback), update(ctx,dt)
scripts/gen/cob-house.js - HOUSE, holesFor, geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/gen/cob-furnish.js - DEFAULTS, geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
scripts/gen/wizard-tower.js - TOWER, geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/wizard-portal.js - onTriggerEnter(ctx,other)
scripts/purple-dragon.js - Violet mount behavior; scripts/gen/purple-dragon.js - dragon geometry/collider; scripts/lib/data/purple-dragon.js - PD tuning
scripts/rowboat.js - mountable boat behavior; scripts/lib/data/rowboat.js - BOAT tuning
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - wantMount(ctx,target), dragonRide(ctx); scripts/home-player-feel.js - player home/interact feel handlers
scripts/gen/road-lamps.js, road-rail.js, courier-horse.js, courier-post.js - procedural highway/courier geometry builders
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain seed/material/site marks, scatter, and derived ground height/material; marks grade paths, lawns, creek and clearings
places/main/cells/*.scene - authored row IDs, locations, tags, initial state and fixed structure/actor relationships
scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - player movement intent, velocity, jump, flight and rope behavior; high-frequency scratch in ctx.session
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/camera.js - player yaw/gait channels and camera view/eye/local-player visibility
scripts/fauna-ground.js / scripts/fauna-small.js, scripts/fairies.js, scripts/pollinators.js - movement/activity and animation state for their tagged populations
scripts/dune.js; scripts/tower-warden.js + wardens.yml; scripts/stone-golem.js + golem.yml - Dune lifecycle, warden patrol/greetings, and Mossback patrol/interaction state respectively
scripts/purple-dragon.js + scripts/lib/data/purple-dragon.js - Violet's phase, flight/rider/home state and tuning; scripts/rowboat.js + rowboat.js data - boat motion and interaction tuning
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - shared mount request/seat/dismount handoff and temporary third-person camera state; mounted entity owns its rider/seat/drop data
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
places/main/config.yaml site/path/river marks + decoration layers -> terrain clearing, grading, lawn material and seeded forest/lawn vegetation; scene rows separately draw paths and structures
road-east/road-west marks in places/main/config.yaml -> pale-cobble terrain road corridors and scatter clearing toward Lumenvale/Hearthmere; authored cells provide discrete road dressing
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; place gravity applies to player body
movement near rope coordinates -> scripts/player.js + lib/data/ropes.js -> climb/slide velocity and deck step-in; player body/camMode -> camera view and visibility
interact press -> scripts/home-player-feel.js + lib/home-interaction.js -> nearest aligned press; pet press writes petAt/petBy for fauna, catio and pasture responses
player mount request -> scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js wantMount -> mount rider/seat state and parent transform; mount rider logic handles step-off and restores camMode

four violet-pad-* pressTo purple-dragon-blueprint -> player mount request -> scripts/purple-dragon.js Violet rest/ride/tour/landing phases; scripts/lib/purple-dragon-clips.js supplies rest, flap and glide animation
mounted player input -> scripts/rowboat.js + scripts/lib/data/rowboat.js -> kinematic rowboat movement, turn, water behavior and near-shore dismount
Dune press ear + scripts/dune.js update -> treat queue/spawn and Dune roam, eat, wag and pet responses using dog clips
fairy-keeper + pollinator-keeper -> scripts/fairies.js and scripts/pollinators.js read tuning and tagged rows -> terrain-following flight, activity clips, greetings and effects
player enters wizard-portal-up/down trigger -> scripts/wizard-portal.js reads state.to + wizard-tower.yml -> teleport to tower deck/outside door, player wizardPortalAt cooldown and portal FX
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest plants, trees, shrubs, ferns, reeds and lawn flora varied by layer, kind and terrain
scripts/gen/cob-house.js + scripts/gen/cob-furnish.js - tree-centered multi-level cob home and furnishing family; parameters select item, dimensions, palette and seeded detail
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - reusable bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed
scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - perimeter runs and gates vary by points, width and style; stone style builds coursed limestone wall, coping, moss/ivy and piers

scripts/gen/animal-{bear,deer,fox,wolf}.js + fauna-ground.js and scripts/gen/critter-{bird,duck,rabbit,squirrel}.js + fauna-small.js - shared large/small fauna behavior varied by species, geometry and animation
scripts/gen/flower-bed.js + lawn-sprig.js + garden-statue.js - garden dressing varied by shape, dimensions, palette and plant/statue kind

scripts/gen/grand-avenue.js, grand-gate.js + grand-gate-leaf.js and warden-tower.js + tower-warden.js - repeated avenue/gate/tower structures and proximity/patrol actors varied by dimensions, orientation and actor
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - shared mount seating and step-off used by dragon/boat mounts; behavior and seat/drop state vary by mount
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
migrationNotes: forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main's river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).

Keep places/main/config.yaml material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated with scene placement; Spawn/home grounds are around (0,-27), while picnic, quad garden and wizard tower are separate sites.
Configured terrain path marks grade/materialize terrain and clear scatter; scene path generators such as grounds-plan draw visible flagstone and do not replace those terrain jobs.
The den-creek follows authored river points through Spawn under creek-bridge-avenue toward the back pond; den-creek-banks and creek-banks scene dressing are separate and should track that course.

road-east and road-west are long terrain paths ending near z=-235 and z=-465, respectively, with cobblepale material and separate verge clearing; keep their points aligned if editing highway dressing.

dragon-rider accepts targets tagged dragon or mount (pressTo can redirect to the mount); mounted target state supplies seat/seatYaw/thirdPerson/dropAt, so preserve this interface for Violet and rowboat.
